subject.title: fix(auth): count token-type profiles in provider health status rollup

question: Should the gateway provider-health contract intentionally use effective token/setup-token credentials as the fallback status source when no effective OAuth credential exists?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well-proven, but this deliberately changes a compatibility-sensitive status policy and should be explicitly accepted by the assigned owner before landing.

options.title: Accept the bounded rollup
options.body: Land the gateway-only OAuth-first/token-fallback policy with the included explicit-order and API-key regression coverage.

options.title: Retain OAuth-only status
options.body: Decline the policy change and accept that setup-token migrations continue to produce a false missing warning on this status surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded rollup
recommendation.body: Land the gateway-only OAuth-first/token-fallback policy with the included explicit-order and API-key regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned and prepared the current exact-head implementation, proof, and final test adjustment for this behavior.
